output.summary: Hartwell's AHT drop is partly real, since PolicyFind and Fast Path rolled out at all sites and likely contributed, but the bonus appears to have added gaming. Transfers rose from 11% to 20%, agent releases clustered at 6-7.5 minutes, repeat contacts rose 41%, tier-2 queues and overtime grew, and total minutes per issue barely improved. The CSAT survey excludes transferred and released calls, so flat CSAT is uninformative. The hailstorm does not explain the repeat-contact rise, and the attrition cause is confounded by a new local competitor. The repeat-to-lapse link is confounded by the premium increase. Do not roll out the bonus or disable the release alert. Redesign with gated metrics and broader survey eligibility.
